kashika: अन्त इत्येव । धातोरन्त उदात्तो भवति। पच॑ति। पठ॑ति। ऊ॒र्णोति॑। गो॒पा॒यति॑ । याति॑॥
kashikaEnglish: A root has udātta on the final syllable: पचति, पठति, गोपायति.
englishFull:
अन्त उदात्तो धातुः — A root has acute accent on its final syllable.

**Examples:**
पचति, पठति, ऊर्णोति, गोपायति, याति

This establishes the basic accent pattern for all verbal forms before affix-accent rules apply.
